An "official announcement" means a statement by the person themselves, their authorized representative, or the official body governing the office that the person will be departing from the office. Such announcements must be reported by at least one Source Agency to be considered official. Temporary absences such as medical leave, suspension with possibility of return, or delegation of duties while retaining the office do NOT constitute leaving office. Death does NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion for this Contract. Forced departures (termination, impeachment and removal, etc.) satisfy the Payout Criterion even without a prior announcement.

“Dropped out” means any of the following:
Max Miller announces they are ending, suspending, or withdrawing from their campaign
Max Miller files official withdrawal paperwork with relevant election authorities
Max Miller publicly states they are no longer seeking the office
Max Miller endorses another candidate while stating they are no longer running
Max Miller is disqualified by election authorities or courts and does not appeal

The following do NOT constitute dropping out:
Losing a primary or election
Failing to qualify for debates or ballots
Temporarily suspending campaign activities without withdrawing
Being eliminated through the normal election process
Reducing campaign activities while remaining a candidate

Once someone drops out per above criteria, the market resolves YES even if they later re-enter
“Suspending” a campaign is treated as dropping out unless Max Miller explicitly states they remain a candidate
For primary races, dropping out of the presidential race entirely counts as dropping out of that party’s primary
Withdrawing from the race counts even if the person remains on the ballot

KXPIRROOUT.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
KXPIRROOUT.rules_primary: If Jeanine Pirro leaves as United States Attorney for the District of Columbia before Aug 7, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXPIRROOUT.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.
KXPIRROOUT.title: Will Jeanine Pirro announce their departure as United States Attorney for the District of Columbia before Aug 7, 2026?

KXZELENSKYYOUT.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the person announces departure or actually leaves office.
KXZELENSKYYOUT.rules_primary: If Volodymyr Zelenskyy has either officially announced their intention to leave as President of Ukraine or has actually left as President of Ukraine before Jul 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXZELENSKYYOUT.rules_secondary:
An "official announcement" means a statement by the person themselves, their authorized representative, or the official body governing the office that the person will be departing from the office. Such announcements must be reported by at least one Source Agency to be considered official. The announcement must not specify they are leaving in more than a year from the statement, in which case the market does not resolve to Yes.

"Leaving office" means the person no longer holds the office in any capacity, including but not limited to: resignation (effective), termination, removal, impeachment and removal, recall, or the expiration of their term without renewal. Temporary absences such as medical leave, suspension with possibility of return, or delegation of duties while retaining the office do NOT constitute leaving office. Death does NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion for this Contract. Forced departures (termination, impeachment and removal, etc.) satisfy the Payout Criterion even without a prior announcement.
KXZELENSKYYOUT.title: Will Volodymyr Zelenskyy leave President of Ukraine before Jul 1, 2026?

This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.

KXBIRTHTOURISMVOTE.rules_secondary:
This includes:
Roll call votes
Recorded votes
Yea-and-nay votes
Electronic votes (in the House)
Division/standing votes

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Voice votes where individual member positions are not recorded
Unanimous consent agreements without a recorded vote
Votes in committee, unless the bill/motion specifically refers to a committee vote
Procedural determinations by the presiding officer
Deemed passage without an actual vote

For clarity:
A vote on cloture regarding the bill/motion, including cloture on a motion to proceed to the bill/motion, DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on the rule governing debate of the bill/motion DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion if the bill/motion specifically refers to that rule
A vote on a motion to proceed to the bill/motion DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on final passage DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on an amendment to the bill/motion does NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion unless the bill/motion specifically refers to that amendment

KXCANUSDEAL.rules_secondary:
An agreement is concluded if either:

it is signed or formally executed by authorized officials of both governments, or
both governments announce that negotiations have concluded and that the agreed tariff changes are being implemented, or those tariff changes take legal effect in both countries under the agreement.

An agreement can be concluded even if individual sectors remain subject to further negotiation, and regardless of when the agreed changes take effect.

The following do NOT count:

Anything announced before Issuance, including the announcements of August 18 and 19, 2026 of a deal reached, agreed in principle, or pending final documentation, and any draft agreement reported before Issuance
An agreement announced as reached by only one of the two governments
A framework, term sheet, memorandum of understanding or joint communique that both governments describe as still subject to negotiation of its core terms
A temporary tariff pause, suspension or deadline extension not accompanied by a concluded agreement
Continued or resumed negotiations, however described
Action taken unilaterally by one government

Only reporting from a Source Agency qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.
KXCANUSDEAL.title: Will it be reported by a Source Agency that Canada and the United States have concluded a final trade agreement before Aug 24, 2026?

Roll call votes
Recorded votes
Yea-and-nay votes
Electronic votes (in the House)
Division/standing votes

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Voice votes where individual member positions are not recorded

A vote on final passage DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on an amendment to the bill/motion does NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion unless the bill/motion specifically refers to that amendment

KXCOMPANYACTIONTTWO.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the company makes the specified announcement.
KXCOMPANYACTIONTTWO.rules_primary: If Take-Two Interactive or Rockstar Games publicly disclose a numeric figure for Grand Theft Auto VI preorders before Aug 14, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXCOMPANYACTIONTTWO.rules_secondary:
The announcement must be made through official company channels including press releases, SEC filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q), earnings calls, investor presentations, verified social media accounts, or official statements to media subsequently confirmed by the company. CEO statements through official channels qualify. Rumors, speculation, unconfirmed reports, leaked information, third-party announcements without company confirmation, and preliminary discussions do not qualify. The announcement must occur after market issuance. Companies are tracked through rebranding and name changes representing the same business entity.

Qualifying Announcements include:
An exact figure (e.g., "5.2 million preorders," "$450 million in preorder value")
An approximated or rounded figure accompanied by qualifying language such as "approximately," "roughly," "around," "nearly," "over," "more than," or "up to," provided a specific number is stated (e.g., "roughly 5 million preorders," "over $450 million in sales")
A bounded numeric range (e.g., "between 4 and 5 million preorders")

Non-Qualifying Announcements may include but are not limited to:
Superlative or comparative claims without an accompanying figure (e.g., "record-breaking," "highest preorders in company history," "strongest launch ever")
Vague magnitude language without a number (e.g., "massive demand," "unprecedented interest," "exceeded expectations")
Percentage-only comparisons without a base figure (e.g., "preorders up 300% over RDR2" does not qualify unless RDR2's base figure or the resulting absolute number is also stated in the same disclosure)
KXCOMPANYACTIONTTWO.title: Will Take-Two Interactive or Rockstar Games announce publicly disclose a numeric figure for Grand Theft Auto VI preorders before Aug 14, 2026?

KXDATACENTERMORATORIUM.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted

KXDATACENTERMORATORIUM.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

KXFDAAPPROVE.rules_primary: If the FDA approves gedatolisib for HR+/HER2-, PIK3CA wild-type advanced breast cancer for marketing before Jul 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXFDAAPPROVE.rules_secondary:
An approval is defined as:

For new drugs: FDA issuance of an approval letter for a New Drug Application (NDA) or Biologics License Application (BLA)
For already-marketed drugs seeking new indications: FDA approval of a supplemental NDA (sNDA) or supplemental BLA (sBLA) for the specific indication referenced
For generic drugs: FDA approval of an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA)
For biosimilars: FDA approval of a 351(k) application

The following constitute approvals that trigger the Payout Criterion:

Standard approval (traditional approval based on clinical benefit)
Accelerated approval (based on surrogate endpoints)
Approval with Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS)
Approval with restricted distribution or indication limitations, except compassionate use/expanded access programs

The following do NOT constitute approvals:

Complete Response Letters (CRLs) indicating the application cannot be approved in its current form
Approvable letters that require additional actions before approval
Tentative approvals pending patent or exclusivity expiration
FDA requests for additional information or studies
Extension of Prescription Drug User Fee Amendments dates
Approval for compassionate use or expanded access programs only
Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) without full approval
Approval only for export or for use outside the United States

If the FDA issues a Complete Response Letter before Jul 1, 2027, the market will resolve to No unless the FDA subsequently approves gedatolisib for HR+/HER2-, PIK3CA wild-type advanced breast cancer after addressing the CRL concerns and before Jul 1, 2027.

If the FDA convenes an Advisory Committee that votes against approval but the FDA approves gedatolisib for HR+/HER2-, PIK3CA wild-type advanced breast cancer anyway before Jul 1, 2027, the market will resolve to Yes.

If gedatolisib for HR+/HER2-, PIK3CA wild-type advanced breast cancer receives accelerated approval that is later withdrawn before Jul 1, 2027, the market will resolve based on whether the initial accelerated approval occurred after Issuance (Yes), regardless of the subsequent withdrawal.

If the drug sponsor withdraws the application before FDA action and before Jul 1, 2027, the market will resolve to No immediately.
KXFDAAPPROVE.subtitle: Before Jul 1, 2027
KXFDAAPPROVE.title: Will the FDA approve gedatolisib for HR+/HER2-, PIK3CA wild-type advanced breast cancer before Jul 1, 2027?

custom_strike.Topic: Fort Wayne, Indiana ends its use of Flock Safety license plate reader cameras

KXFLOCKDROPPED.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXFLOCKDROPPED.rules_primary: If Fort Wayne, Indiana ends its use of Flock Safety license plate reader cameras after Issuance and before Feb 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXFLOCKDROPPED.rules_secondary:
A jurisdiction ends its use of Flock Safety cameras if its governing body, chief executive, or police department:

terminates a Flock Safety contract before the contract's scheduled end date, or
declines to renew or extend a Flock Safety contract, or declines to allow an automatic renewal to take effect, or
allows a Flock Safety contract to reach its scheduled end date without entering a renewal or replacement agreement, or
otherwise discontinues the jurisdiction's use of Flock Safety cameras, including by moving to a different license plate reader vendor.

The action must occur on or after August 21, 2026, and be reported before February 1, 2027.

The following do NOT count:

Renewing or extending the contract, even with added privacy safeguards, audit requirements or use restrictions
A temporary pause, camera deactivation, or moratorium that leaves the underlying contract in force and does not prevent its renewal
A non-binding resolution, advisory referendum or committee recommendation that the official empowered to act has not acted upon

Each jurisdiction is judged on its own, and action by a jurisdiction not named in this event does not affect any market here.

Only reporting from a Source Agency qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.
KXFLOCKDROPPED.title: Will it be reported by a Source Agency that Fort Wayne, Indiana ends its use of Flock Safety license plate reader cameras before Feb 1, 2027?

On August 1, 2026, OpenAI publicly disclosed "Astra," an internal model described by OpenAI as its next major frontier system, citing results including the resolution of ten previously open mathematics problems - https://openai.com/index/ten-advances-in-mathematics/ 

Qualifying Release: The Payout Criterion is satisfied if OpenAI releases a model that either (a) is publicly named "Astra" (including numbered, lettered, or suffixed variants such as "Astra 1," "Astra 6," or "GPT-6 Astra"), or (b) is confirmed by OpenAI, or by a consensus of credible reporting, to share the same underlying model — including the same base architecture, weights, or training run — as the model referenced in OpenAI's August 1, 2026 disclosure, regardless of the commercial name, safety configuration, or access tier under which it is ultimately released. A separately-branded release that is derived from or built on the same underlying model as the disclosed Astra model satisfies this clause even if OpenAI markets it as a distinct product (e.g., a safety-restricted variant or a differently-priced tier), provided the shared underlying model is confirmed by OpenAI or by a consensus of credible reporting.

Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

KXROBOTAXIAREA.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXROBOTAXIAREA.rules_primary: If Tesla robotaxi service is offered to the general public in Florida before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXROBOTAXIAREA.rules_secondary:
For "offered to": Tesla has launched a robotaxi service in Florida that satisfies ALL of the following criteria:

The service allows members of the general public to request rides through a publicly accessible application or platform (not limited to Tesla employees, beta testers, or invite-only participants)
The vehicles operate without any human driver or safety monitor physically present in the driver's seat who is actively controlling the vehicle during normal operation
The service charges fares or fees for rides (free promotional rides alone do not qualify)

For "removed from": Tesla has discontinued, suspended, or withdrawn a previously operational robotaxi service in Florida that met all the "offered to" criteria above, where:

The service is no longer accepting new ride requests from the general public for any period of time as a result of a decision by Tesla to suspend operations in the area, and such suspension is not explicitly characterized as temporary (e.g., due to weather, maintenance, or system upgrades). The Payout Criterion is not satisfied by short-term service interruptions that are clearly communicated as temporary or expected to resume.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:

If a government orders Tesla to cease ongoing services but they do not comply, then the market does not resolve to Yes
Services limited to Tesla employees, contractors, or their guests
Beta tests, pilot programs, or demonstrations
Services requiring special invitations, access codes, or pre-approval to use
Vehicles with human safety drivers, monitors, or operators in any seat of the vehicle who can take control
Temporary suspensions due to weather or technical issues
Services operating only with remote human teleoperators controlling each vehicle continuously
Test fleets that are not charging fares to the general public
Announcements of future launches without actual operational service
KXROBOTAXIAREA.title: Will Tesla robotaxi be offered to the general public in Florida before Jan 1, 2027?

KXTRUMPCOUNTRIES.rules_secondary:
The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.
KXTRUMPCOUNTRIES.title: Will Donald Trump visit Turkey before Jan 1, 2027?

KXTRUMPENDORSELOSS.rules_secondary:
Endorsements are determined per the specifications of the ENDORSE contract. An endorsement must be made before the primary to count; if Trump endorses multiple candidates in the same race, that race is excluded. "Primary" includes runoffs and top-two/jungle primaries (e.g., California), and any election titled a primary. A candidate who withdraws before the primary is not counted as a loss; a candidate who advances past a top-two primary and then withdraws is counted as a loss. Only primaries held after Apr 10, 2026 and before Sept 16, 2026 are included.

Clarification (06/29/26): To clarify, when a race goes to a runoff, the runoff is the operative contest, consistent with the rule that "Primary" includes runoffs. Both the South Carolina governor and Oklahoma 1st District races are excluded. In each, Trump endorsed two different candidates in the same race. In South Carolina he co-endorsed Evette and Wilson before the runoff. In Oklahoma, he endorsed Lahmeyer before the June primary and then endorsed Tedford before Tedford secured the nomination following Lahmeyer’s withdrawal. The exclusion rule applies whether the two endorsements are made together or in sequence, so both races are excluded.

KXTRUMPMOJTABA.rules_primary: If Donald Trump and Mojtaba Khamenei meet (including phone calls) before Aug 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXTRUMPMOJTABA.rules_secondary:
A meeting is defined as any of the following:

An in-person encounter where both parties are physically present in the same location
A virtual meeting via video conference where both parties can see and hear each other in real-time
A phone call where both parties speak directly to each other
Any combination of the above where the parties interact directly in real-time

The following qualify as meetings (though this list is not exhaustive):

Formal bilateral meetings, summits, or conferences
Informal encounters at multilateral events if documented by Source Agencies
Working dinners, lunches, or other meal meetings
Pull-aside meetings or corridor conversations if documented
Home visits or meetings at non-official locations

The following do NOT qualify as meetings:

Being present at the same event without direct interaction
Exchanging written correspondence
Communication through intermediaries without direct contact
Pre-recorded messages or asynchronous communication
Meetings cancelled after being scheduled
Near-misses where parties were scheduled to meet but did not
KXTRUMPMOJTABA.title: Donald Trump and Mojtaba Khamenei meet before Aug 1, 2026?

If a last traded price is not available or is not logically consistent, or if the Exchange determines at its sole discretion that the last traded prices prior to death do not represent a fair settlement value, the Outcome Review Committee will be responsible for making a binding determination of fair allocation.

KXTRUMPSTATES.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the visit occurs.
KXTRUMPSTATES.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has physically travelled to and been present within the geographic boundaries of South Carolina after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXTRUMPSTATES.rules_secondary:
The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.

KXUSAIRANAGREEMENT.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXUSAIRANAGREEMENT.rules_primary: If the United States has agreed to, signed, or accepted a new Iran-US nuclear deal before Aug 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXUSAIRANAGREEMENT.rules_secondary:
An agreement also made with other countries (i.e. multilaterally) is still encompassed if the United States participates. "A new Iran-US nuclear deal" means a formal written agreement signed by authorized representatives of both the United States and Iran that (1) imposes verifiable restrictions on Iran's nuclear program, including limits on uranium enrichment, centrifuge numbers, or nuclear facility operations, AND (2) provides for the lifting, suspension, or modification of at least one US economic sanction on Iran in exchange for Iran's nuclear commitments.

Clarification (04/19/26): The Agreement Long rulebook variable defines the nature of the qualifying instrument: it must be a formal written agreement signed by authorized representatives of both governments. It does not impose a precondition that the signing itself must occur before resolution. Because the Payout Criterion is satisfied if the United States has "agreed to, signed, or accepted" such an instrument, both governments publicly and officially agreeing to the terms of what will be a qualifying written agreement is sufficient to resolve the market to Yes, even if the formal signing has not yet taken place.

Clarification (06/02/26): A qualifying instrument must impose "verifiable restrictions on Iran's nuclear program." A restriction is "verifiable" only where it establishes a concrete, objectively ascertainable standard (a defined limit, prohibition, quantity, or monitoring provision) against which compliance could in principle be confirmed; a general expression of intent that fixes no such standard is not considered “verifiable” for the purposes of this event. Accordingly, a bare pledge not to develop or pursue nuclear weapons, unaccompanied by any concrete limit on Iran's nuclear materials, activities, or facilities, does not on its own satisfy criterion (1). Conversely, a commitment to completely 'stop' or ‘suspend’ a specific nuclear activity (such as uranium enrichment) establishes a concrete prohibition (an implicit limit of zero) and qualifies as a restriction, whereas a vague promise to 'reduce' activities without a defined metric or monitoring mechanism does not. The enumerated examples (limits on uranium enrichment, centrifuge numbers, or nuclear facility operations) are illustrative and not exhaustive: a formal, verifiable commitment to remove, transfer, or cap Iran's stock of enriched uranium, confirmable by the receiving state or an oversight body, is a restriction on Iran's nuclear program and satisfies criterion (1). In every case, criterion (2) must independently be met.

Clarification (06/17/26): To clarify, the U.S.–Iran memorandum of understanding reportedly now in effect does not satisfy criterion (1) of the definition of a "new Iran-US nuclear deal," and this market will therefore not resolve to Yes on the basis of that instrument at this time. The memorandum provides for the existing state of Iran's nuclear program to be maintained pending a subsequent agreement, and defers the disposition of Iran's stockpile of enriched uranium to a mechanism to be mutually agreed in that subsequent agreement. That it states a minimum methodology for that future mechanism — down-blending on site under IAEA supervision — constrains the form of a mechanism yet to be agreed, but specifies no quantity, enrichment level, or completion deadline for the down-blending. An instrument that provides for maintaining Iran's nuclear program at an unspecified status quo, or that defers its substantive nuclear commitments to a subsequent agreement, does not by itself establish the concrete, objectively ascertainable standard that a "verifiable" restriction requires.
KXUSAIRANAGREEMENT.subtitle: Before August
KXUSAIRANAGREEMENT.title: Will the US agree to a new Iranian nuclear deal before August?

KXADJOURNRECESS.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXADJOURNRECESS.rules_primary: If the Senate has conducted any recorded vote on any motion, resolution, or order whose adoption would begin or provide for the Senate’s scheduled August 2026 break, including through pro forma sessions after Issuance and before Aug 10, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXADJOURNRECESS.rules_secondary:
This includes:
Roll call votes
Recorded votes
Yea-and-nay votes
Electronic votes (in the House)
Division/standing votes

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Voice votes where individual member positions are not recorded
Unanimous consent agreements without a recorded vote
Votes in committee, unless the bill/motion specifically refers to a committee vote
Procedural determinations by the presiding officer
Deemed passage without an actual vote

For clarity:
A vote on cloture regarding the bill/motion, including cloture on a motion to proceed to the bill/motion, DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on the rule governing debate of the bill/motion DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion if the bill/motion specifically refers to that rule
A vote on a motion to proceed to the bill/motion DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on final passage DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on an amendment to the bill/motion does NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion unless the bill/motion specifically refers to that amendment
KXADJOURNRECESS.title: Will the Senate vote on any motion, resolution, or order whose adoption would begin or provide for the Senate’s scheduled August 2026 break, including through pro forma sessions?

KXHFHOUSING.early_close_condition: If this event occurs, the market will close the following 10:00 AM ET.
KXHFHOUSING.rules_primary: If a bill becomes law that imposes an excise tax on investment firm ownership of single-family homes (including if the tax is only imposed on newly bought homes) or bans investment firms from owning single-family homes outright (or which bans buying new homes) before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXHFHOUSING.rules_secondary:
An example of such a bill is here. Such legislation can have an assets under management or net value requirement for the funds and still be included within the Payout Criterion (e.g. it only applies to funds with assets under management of at least $50 million). Such legislation may also only tax certain assets, e.g. only second and third homes but not first owned by a firm.

Clarification: A bill satisfies the Payout Criterion if it establishes a baseline prohibition or tax on institutional investors buying single-family homes, regardless of specific statutory carve-outs, asset exemptions, or firm-size thresholds. For example, the May 14 House-amended version of the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act qualifies because it explicitly bans these purchases, and the inclusion of various transaction exceptions (such as build-to-rent programs) does not disqualify it.
KXHFHOUSING.subtitle: Before Jan 1, 2027
KXHFHOUSING.title: Will a bill become law taxing or banning hedge funds from owning homes before election day?

KXNEWDEAL.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXNEWDEAL.rules_primary: If the President announces a new trade deal before Sep 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXNEWDEAL.rules_secondary:
For the purposes of this Contract, an announcement must satisfy ALL of the following criteria:

Made through official channels including White House press conferences, official White House statements, presidential speeches, official presidential social media accounts, or official presidential appearances
Explicitly describes the arrangement as a "trade deal," "trade agreement," "trade memorandum," "trade pact," or uses substantially similar language indicating a formal trade arrangement
Involves at least one foreign country, territory, or international trade bloc

Preliminary agreements, frameworks, or agreements in principle do count as long as they are presented as a new trade-related agreement. It also includes modifications or re-negotiated versions of previous agreements. New arrangements include, but are not limited to:

Agreements with a country, territory, or trade bloc with which the United States does not currently have a comprehensive trade agreement
Agreements that cover trade sectors, industries, or product categories not previously covered by existing U.S. trade agreements with the same partner(s)
An agreement that establishes fundamentally different trade mechanisms, dispute resolution procedures, or regulatory frameworks compared to existing agreements with the same partner(s)

The following qualify as announcements that trigger the Payout Criterion:

A new bilateral trade agreement between the U.S. and another country
A new multilateral trade agreement involving the U.S. and multiple countries
Trade memoranda of understanding that establish new trade frameworks
Sector-specific trade deals (e.g., agricultural, technology, energy trade agreements)
Trade arrangements that are announced as "agreements in principle" or "framework agreements"

The following do NOT trigger the Payout Criterion:

Informal statements, leaks, or "sources say" reports without official presidential announcement
Announcements of trade negotiations beginning, trade talks being scheduled, or intentions to pursue trade deals
Tariff announcements, trade sanctions, or trade enforcement actions that do not establish new bilateral or multilateral trade frameworks
Congressional approval or ratification of previously announced deals
Announcements of trade visits, delegations, or diplomatic meetings without announcing an actual deal
Announcements regarding domestic trade policy changes that do not involve foreign partners
KXNEWDEAL.title: When will Trump announce a new trade deal?

KXPERSONPUBLIC.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the person is seen in public.
KXPERSONPUBLIC.rules_primary: If Barack Obama has been seen in public starting 10:00 AM Jul 1, 2026 and before Aug 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXPERSONPUBLIC.rules_secondary:
All of the following criteria must be met:

Physical Presence: Barack Obama is physically present (not virtual/holographic) and alive
Consciousness: Barack Obama appears conscious and aware (not unconscious, comatose, or incapacitated)
Public Setting: The sighting occurs in one of the following:
   A public space accessible to the general public (streets, parks, shops, restaurants)
   A ticketed public event (concerts, sports events, conferences)
   An official public appearance (government events, ceremonies, press conferences)
   A semi-public venue where public access is normal (hotels, airports, train stations)

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:

Pre-recorded or archival footage presented as current
Private events closed to the general public (private parties, closed meetings)
Medical facilities, private residences, or restricted areas
Virtual appearances (video calls, holograms, avatars)
Body doubles or impersonators
Corpses, funeral viewings, or posthumous footage

Examples that WOULD resolve to Yes:

Barack Obama attends a movie premiere and is photographed on the red carpet by multiple Source Agencies
Barack Obama gives a live press conference covered by news media
Barack Obama attends a sporting event and is shown on the stadium's video screens

Examples that would NOT resolve to Yes:

Pre-recorded video message
Private party footage leaked online
Someone claiming to be Barack Obama but without Source Agency confirmation
Barack Obama appearing via video link from home
KXPERSONPUBLIC.title: Will Barack Obama be seen in public before Aug 1, 2026?

KXPRADHAMOUT.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
KXPRADHAMOUT.rules_primary: If Dharmendra Pradhan leaves as Minister of Education before Sep 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXPRADHAMOUT.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.
KXPRADHAMOUT.subtitle: Before Sep 1, 2026
KXPRADHAMOUT.title: Will Dharmendra Pradhan announce their departure as Minister of Education before Sep 1, 2026?

KXREHEARBIRTHRIGHT.rules_secondary:
If no petition for rehearing is filed by the applicable filing deadline, this market resolves No.

Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

KXSULYOKOUT.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
KXSULYOKOUT.rules_primary: If Tamas Sulyok leaves as President of Hungary before Aug 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXSULYOKOUT.rules_secondary:
Tamas Sulyok must have an actual departure date and vacate the role within the time period.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.
KXSULYOKOUT.title: Will Tamas Sulyok be out as President of Hungary before Aug 1, 2026?

KXTRUMPMEET.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXTRUMPMEET.rules_primary: If Donald Trump and Zohran Mamdani meet (including phone calls) before Sep 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXTRUMPMEET.rules_secondary:
A meeting is defined as any of the following:

An in-person encounter where both parties are physically present in the same location
A virtual meeting via video conference where both parties can see and hear each other in real-time
A phone call where both parties speak directly to each other
Any combination of the above where the parties interact directly in real-time

The following qualify as meetings (though this list is not exhaustive):

Formal bilateral meetings, summits, or conferences
Informal encounters at multilateral events if documented by Source Agencies
Working dinners, lunches, or other meal meetings
Pull-aside meetings or corridor conversations if documented
Home visits or meetings at non-official locations

The following do NOT qualify as meetings:

Being present at the same event without direct interaction
Exchanging written correspondence
Communication through intermediaries without direct contact
Pre-recorded messages or asynchronous communication
Meetings cancelled after being scheduled
Near-misses where parties were scheduled to meet but did not
KXTRUMPMEET.title: Donald Trump and Zohran Mamdani meet before Sep 1, 2026?

KXUSVENEZOIL.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event described in the Payout Criterion occurs.
KXUSVENEZOIL.rules_primary: If the US agrees to or announces a new deal granting the U.S. government ownership or lease rights to Venezuelan oil fields after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXUSVENEZOIL.rules_secondary:
The deal must grant the U.S. federal government an ownership interest in, or a lease of, one or more Venezuelan oil fields, directly or through an entity holding the interest on its behalf. Equity in an entity owning the fields also qualifies. No minimum ownership percentage or lease term is required.

A new deal is an agreement first reached after Issuance. Reannouncements, implementation, or continuation of arrangements agreed before Issuance do NOT qualify. Oil purchases or supply commitments, custody or control of oil-sale proceeds, sanctions permissions, and private-company deals without an ownership or lease interest for the U.S. government do NOT qualify.

An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties, accords, or binding agreements
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify. Announcements with specified future implementation dates qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions, negotiations, or expressions of interest without commitment
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents or unofficial reports not confirmed by government sources
Think-tank recommendations without government adoption
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of previously announced commitments
KXUSVENEZOIL.title: Will the US agree to or announce a new deal granting the U.S. government ownership or lease rights to Venezuelan oil fields before Jan 1, 2027?

KXVOTEBLANCHE.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire following the first vote to confirm Todd Blanche or their nomination being withdrawn.

KXVOTEBLANCHE.rules_secondary:
Should such a vote result in the rejection of the Nominee via a procedure that does not result in the recording of a tally of votes, or should a withdrawal of the nominee's nomination be formally communicated to the United States Senate, this market shall resolve to No. Should a vote result in the confirmation of the Nominee via a procedure that does not result in the recording of a tally of votes, this market shall resolve to Yes. Should more than one Senate confirmation vote on the confirmation of the Nominee to the Office be held, the outcome of the first such vote will be used to resolve this market. If the nominee is withdrawn (or intent to nominate a nominee is withdrawn by the President or President-elect), then the market will resolve to No. 

The outcomes of committee votes, hearings, or reports, cloture votes and other procedural votes will have no impact on the resolution of this market. Once the vote has been closed and the correct result of the vote has been announced, a request by Tommy Tuberville to add, remove, or alter a vote shall not be considered for purposes of resolving this market, regardless of any change to the official vote tally reported by the website senate.gov or any other official source.
KXVOTEBLANCHE.title: Will Tommy Tuberville vote for Todd Blanche?

Once the vote has been closed and the correct result of the vote has been announced, a request by Bill Cassidy to add, remove, or alter a vote shall not be considered for purposes of resolving this market, regardless of any change to the official vote tally reported by the website senate.gov or any other official source.

KXWEPFUNDEND.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXWEPFUNDEND.rules_primary: If the U.S. Department of Justice formally terminates the Anti-Weaponization Fund through a legally operative written instrument  after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXWEPFUNDEND.rules_secondary:
Qualifying instruments include a rescission or replacement of the Attorney General’s order that legally removes the Department’s obligation to establish or operate the Fund, a written modification or termination of the relevant provisions of the Trump v. IRS settlement agreement, or a sworn declaration filed in federal court committing the Department not to establish, fund, or operate the Fund. Statements, testimony, or filings that merely describe the Fund as abandoned or state a present intention not to proceed do not qualify.

Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.
KXWEPFUNDEND.title: Will it be reported by any of the Source Agencies that the U.S. Department of Justice formally terminates the Anti-Weaponization Fund through a legally operative written instrument before Jan 1, 2027?

KXWIDGOVRECOUNT.rules_secondary:

Routine canvassing, audits, corrections to election returns, or other vote-review procedures that are not such a recount do not qualify.

Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

KXNBANEXTTEAMOUTLET.rules_secondary:
In order for the market to resolve Yes, the call must be intended to be a formal projection or declaration of LeBron James' next Pro Basketball team. 
Leaks, rumors, or statements attributed to Shams Charania that are not published through an official channel of the outlet do not count.
An announcement of LeBron James' next Pro Basketball team that is later shown to be factually incorrect, provided it was made in good faith through Shams Charania's ordinary editorial process, will still resolve the market to Yes.
An outlet reporting on, aggregating, or repeating another outlet's call (e.g., "Outlet B reports that Outlet A has called the race") does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.
If LeBron James' next Pro Basketball team is first called by an outlet, entity, or individual that is not listed within this event, this shall not affect the resolution of this Contract.
If no outlet listed within this event calls LeBron James' next Pro Basketball team after Issuance and before Oct 23, 2026, then all markets resolve to No.
If two or more outlets, entities, or individuals listed within the market announce LeBron James' next Pro Basketball team at a time that cannot be distinguished based on available timestamp data, the Contract will resolve as a tie. Each tied outlet will payout as follows:
   Yes payout: $1/N, rounded down to the nearest cent (N = number of tied outlets)
   No payout: $1 minus the Yes payout

KXNFLOWNERSTAKE.rules_secondary:
The sale, transfer, or divestiture of an ownership stake (whether controlling or minority) in an NFL team is deemed to occur upon the first formal, official public announcement of the action by its ownership, the Governing League, or any of the Source Agencies. 
In order to be eligible for resolution, the announcement must report the action as confirmed and finalized (not merely rumored or under negotiation), regardless of whether the transaction has yet closed or received all the requisite approvals.
If no NFL team sells, transfers, or divests an ownership stake in their team (whether controlling or minority) after Issuance and before Jul 1, 2027, then the market titled "No Team" resolves to Yes.
If multiple teams announce simultaneously or such that no clear first-mover can be determined by the Source Agencies, each tied team’s market will resolve at 1 / N, where N is the number of tied teams.

KXAKDROPOUTAUG.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the candidate drops out.
KXAKDROPOUTAUG.rules_primary: If Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins drops out of the 2026 Alaska Governor race before Sep 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXAKDROPOUTAUG.rules_secondary:
“Dropped out” means any of the following:
the candidate announces they are ending, suspending, or withdrawing from their campaign
the candidate files official withdrawal paperwork with relevant election authorities
the candidate publicly states they are no longer seeking the office
the candidate endorses another candidate while stating they are no longer running
the candidate is disqualified by election authorities or courts and does not appeal

The following do NOT constitute dropping out:
Losing a primary or election
Failing to qualify for debates or ballots
Temporarily suspending campaign activities without withdrawing
Being eliminated through the normal election process
Reducing campaign activities while remaining a candidate

Key provisions:
Once someone drops out per above criteria, the market resolves YES even if they later re-enter
“Suspending” a campaign is treated as dropping out unless the candidate explicitly states they remain a candidate
Withdrawing from the race counts even if the person remains on the ballot

Each market in this event resolves independently. A candidate not named in this event dropping out does not resolve any market here.

KXAKDROPOUTAUG.title: Will Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins drop out of the Alaska Governor race before Sep 1, 2026?

KXBARNESENDORSE.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the endorsement occurs.
KXBARNESENDORSE.rules_primary: If Mandela Barnes publicly endorses No one in the 2026 Wisconsin Governor race before Aug 11, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXBARNESENDORSE.rules_secondary:
An "endorsement" requires:
A clear, affirmative statement of support for candidate's election
The statement must be public (not private communications)
The endorsement must specifically reference the 2026 Wisconsin Governor race or be clearly in context of the 2026 Wisconsin Governor race
The endorsement must come directly from Mandela Barnes or through official channels

The following scenarios would resolve to YES:
Mandela Barnes states "I endorse candidate for [office]"
Mandela Barnes states "I support candidate" with clear reference to the 2026 Wisconsin Governor race
Mandela Barnes states "I'm voting for candidate" publicly
Mandela Barnes states "candidate has my full support" for the 2026 Wisconsin Governor race
Mandela Barnes appears at campaign events specifically to endorse
Mandela Barnes releases official endorsement through their organization
Mandela Barnes allows their name/image to be used in candidate's campaign materials

Statements of obvious sarcasm (or which are immediately followed by clarifications that Mandela Barnes is joking) are NOT encompassed by the Payout Criterion.

The Contract shall resolve immediately upon confirmation of the first qualifying endorsement in the specified race. If multiple candidates are listed for a listed race and exactly one is endorsed, that candidate's strike resolves "Yes" at $1.00 and all other named-candidate strikes resolve "No." If multiple are endorsed, each endorsed candidate's strike resolves "Yes" at a value of ($1.00 / N) rounded down to the nearest $0.01. 

If no endorsement occurs before expiration, the "No one" strike resolves "Yes" at $1.00 and all named-candidate strikes resolve "No."

If a candidate withdraws from, suspends their campaign for, ceases to be a candidate in, or loses the primary or general election for the specified race before a qualifying endorsement is confirmed, their strike may resolve to No in the sole discretion of the Exchange.
KXBARNESENDORSE.title: Will Mandela Barnes endorse No one in the 2026 Wisconsin Governor race before Aug 11, 2026?

KXDROPOUTPRIMARY.rules_primary: If Paul Renner drops out of the 2026 Florida Governor primary before Aug 18, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXDROPOUTPRIMARY.rules_secondary:
“Dropped out” means any of the following:
Paul Renner announces they are ending, suspending, or withdrawing from their campaign
Paul Renner files official withdrawal paperwork with relevant election authorities
Paul Renner publicly states they are no longer seeking the office
Paul Renner endorses another candidate while stating they are no longer running
Paul Renner is disqualified by election authorities or courts and does not appeal

The following do NOT constitute dropping out:
Losing a primary or election
Failing to qualify for debates or ballots
Temporarily suspending campaign activities without withdrawing
Being eliminated through the normal election process
Reducing campaign activities while remaining a candidate

Key provisions:
Once someone drops out per above criteria, the market resolves YES even if they later re-enter
“Suspending” a campaign is treated as dropping out unless Paul Renner explicitly states they remain a candidate
For primary races, dropping out of the presidential race entirely counts as dropping out of that party’s primary
Withdrawing from the race counts even if the person remains on the ballot

KXFRYENDORSE.rules_secondary:
An "endorsement" requires:
A clear, affirmative statement of support for candidate's election
The statement must be public (not private communications)
The endorsement must specifically reference the 2026 South Carolina Senate race or be clearly in context of the 2026 South Carolina Senate race
The endorsement must come directly from Russell Fry or through official channels

The following scenarios would resolve to YES:
Russell Fry states "I endorse candidate for [office]"
Russell Fry states "I support candidate" with clear reference to the 2026 South Carolina Senate race
Russell Fry states "I'm voting for candidate" publicly
Russell Fry states "candidate has my full support" for the 2026 South Carolina Senate race
Russell Fry appears at campaign events specifically to endorse
Russell Fry releases official endorsement through their organization
Russell Fry allows their name/image to be used in candidate's campaign materials

Statements of obvious sarcasm (or which are immediately followed by clarifications that Russell Fry is joking) are NOT encompassed by the Payout Criterion.

The Contract shall resolve immediately upon confirmation of the first qualifying endorsement in the specified race. If no endorsement occurs before expiration, the "No one" strike resolves "Yes" at $1.00 and all named-candidate strikes resolve "No."

If a candidate withdraws from, suspends their campaign for, ceases to be a candidate in, or loses the primary or general election for the specified race before a qualifying endorsement is confirmed, their strike may resolve to No in the sole discretion of the Exchange.

KXLOSEPRIMARYSENATER.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the number of primary losses exceeds the cap or is mathematically guaranteed to fall within a specific range before the expiration date.
KXLOSEPRIMARYSENATER.rules_primary: If the number of Republican Senate members that lose their primary in 2026 before Nov 3, 2026 is at least 4, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXLOSEPRIMARYSENATER.rules_secondary:
To be included, candidates must:

Be running in an election for the office they currently hold (regardless of District), for a party they are currently in, as of primary day for the seat they're contesting in in 2026;
Be running for the nomination of a position whose election day is on the same date as most Congressional elections in 2026, typically an early Tuesday of November;
Lose the Republican primary for that election to another candidate.

In jurisdictions with non-partisan or "top-two" primary systems, an incumbent is not considered to have lost if they advance to the General Election ballot, regardless of their placement relative to other advancing candidates. 

For the purposes of determining eligibility, a candidate is considered to be running for the "office they currently hold" if they are seeking re-election to the same legislative body (House or Senate), regardless of changes to their specific district number or geographic constituency. 

In the event that primaries for an unexpired term (Special Election) and the next full term (General Election) are held concurrently, the Payout Criterion applies exclusively to the results of the primary for the next full term.
KXLOSEPRIMARYSENATER.title: Will at least 4 Senate Republican members lose their primary in 2026?

If no endorsement occurs before expiration, the "No one" strike resolves "Yes" at $1.00 and all named-candidate strikes resolve "No."

If a candidate withdraws from, suspends their campaign for, ceases to be a candidate in, or loses the primary or general election for the specified race before a qualifying endorsement is confirmed, their strike may resolve to No in the sole discretion of the Exchange.

KXPLATNERDROPOUT.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the candidate drops out.

KXPLATNERDROPOUT.rules_secondary:
“Dropped out” means any of the following:
Graham Platner announces they are ending, suspending, or withdrawing from their campaign
Graham Platner files official withdrawal paperwork with relevant election authorities
Graham Platner publicly states they are no longer seeking the office
Graham Platner endorses another candidate while stating they are no longer running
Graham Platner is disqualified by election authorities or courts and does not appeal

The following do NOT constitute dropping out:
Losing a primary or election
Failing to qualify for debates or ballots
Temporarily suspending campaign activities without withdrawing
Being eliminated through the normal election process
Reducing campaign activities while remaining a candidate

Key provisions:
Once someone drops out per above criteria, the market resolves YES even if they later re-enter
“Suspending” a campaign is treated as dropping out unless Graham Platner explicitly states they remain a candidate
For primary races, dropping out of the presidential race entirely counts as dropping out of that party’s primary
Withdrawing from the race counts even if the person remains on the ballot

KXTRUMPENDORSESC.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the endorsement occurs.
KXTRUMPENDORSESC.rules_primary: If Donald Trump publicly endorses Ralph Norman in the 2026 South Carolina Senate race before Aug 11, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXTRUMPENDORSESC.rules_secondary:
An "endorsement" requires:
A clear, affirmative statement of support for candidate's election
The statement must be public (not private communications)
The endorsement must specifically reference the 2026 South Carolina Senate race or be clearly in context of the 2026 South Carolina Senate race
The endorsement must come directly from Donald Trump or through official channels

The following scenarios would resolve to YES:
Donald Trump states "I endorse candidate for [office]"
Donald Trump states "I support candidate" with clear reference to the 2026 South Carolina Senate race
Donald Trump states "I'm voting for candidate" publicly
Donald Trump states "candidate has my full support" for the 2026 South Carolina Senate race
Donald Trump appears at campaign events specifically to endorse
Donald Trump releases official endorsement through their organization
Donald Trump allows their name/image to be used in candidate's campaign materials

Statements of obvious sarcasm (or which are immediately followed by clarifications that Donald Trump is joking) are NOT encompassed by the Payout Criterion.

The Contract shall resolve immediately upon confirmation of the first qualifying endorsement in the specified race. If multiple candidates are listed for a listed race and exactly one is endorsed, that candidate's strike resolves "Yes" at $1.00 and all other named-candidate strikes resolve "No." If multiple are endorsed, each endorsed candidate's strike resolves "Yes" at a value of ($1.00 / N) rounded down to the nearest $0.01. 

If no endorsement occurs before expiration, the "No one" strike resolves "Yes" at $1.00 and all named-candidate strikes resolve "No."

If a candidate withdraws from, suspends their campaign for, ceases to be a candidate in, or loses the primary or general election for the specified race before a qualifying endorsement is confirmed, their strike may resolve to No in the sole discretion of the Exchange.
KXTRUMPENDORSESC.title: Will Donald Trump endorse Ralph Norman in the 2026 South Carolina Senate race before Aug 11, 2026?

KXFOMCGUIDE.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXFOMCGUIDE.rules_primary: If the inclusion of forward-looking rate guidance in the July 2026 FOMC statement is confirmed by any of the Source Agencies after Issuance and before Jul 30, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXFOMCGUIDE.rules_secondary:
The market will resolve to Yes if the July 2026 FOMC statement includes language indicating that the Committee expects, anticipates, intends, or judges it likely that future changes to the target range for the federal funds rate will occur, including future rate cuts, future rate hikes, or future adjustments in either direction.

The market will resolve to No if the statement only describes current economic conditions, the current policy decision, the Committee’s goals, or general data-dependence without indicating a likely future direction for the federal funds rate.
KXFOMCGUIDE.title: Will the July 2026 FOMC statement include forward-looking rate guidance?

KXH200CHINA.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXH200CHINA.rules_primary: If Nvidia H200 chips being delivered to mainland China is confirmed by any of the Source Agencies after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXH200CHINA.rules_secondary:
This market resolves to Yes if any Source Agency confirms that one or more Nvidia H200 chips have been physically delivered to, received in, or imported into mainland China after Issuance and before Jan. 1, 2027.

For this market, “mainland China” means the People’s Republic of China excluding Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. Delivery to Hong Kong, Macau, or Taiwan does not qualify unless a Source Agency confirms that the Nvidia H200 chips were subsequently delivered to, received in, or imported into mainland China.

Regulatory approval, export licenses, purchase orders, contracts, reservations, customer allocations, payment, revenue-recognition statements, manufacturing, packaging, shipment preparation, or statements of intent do not qualify unless a Source Agency confirms physical delivery, receipt, or import into mainland China.

References to Nvidia “H200,” “H200 AI chips,” “H200 GPUs,” “H200 processors,” “H200 accelerators,” or “H200 AI accelerators” qualify, provided the Source Agency is referring to Nvidia H200 chips. References only to other Nvidia chips, including H20, H100, B200, B300, Blackwell, or China-specific modified chips, do not qualify unless the Source Agency also confirms delivery of Nvidia H200 chips.
